decisive_items: An MRI of the hips and pelvis then demonstrated bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement and a left-sided insertional tendinopathy
Colchicine was started for presumed crystal arthropathy
response.rationale: MRI directly shows iliopsoas muscle oedema and insertional tendinopathy, matching the clinical progression of hip pain and weakness; epidural abscess and cauda equina were excluded by MRI, and crystal arthropathy lacks confirmatory evidence and failed colchicine response.

rejected.why: MRI showed no abscess, ruling out epidural abscess.
MRI showed no central canal stenosis or abscess, excluding cauda equina syndrome.
Presumed only; colchicine did not improve symptoms and no crystal evidence was obtained.
